name: Spire Plus
author: wenhuorongbing-netizen
description: Spire Plus is a single gameplay-expansion mod for Slay the Spire 2. It turns Ancient rewards into inspectable relic choices, revises selected vanilla relics, and adds the A11-A20 test ruleset plus preview tools: Blight Sprouts, Rootblight, Firemarked Elites, Banner Rooms, boss dedicated abilities, Branded Form, Crystal Sphere peek, and transform preview. Requires BaseLib. 中文：Spire Plus 是《杀戮尖塔 2》的单一玩法扩展 mod。它把先古之民奖励做成可查看的遗物式选择，调整部分原版遗物，并加入 A11-A20 测试进阶与预览工具。奖励可以更强，但代价、触发时机和后续结算必须能读懂。
